name: Home Assistant
description: Brings the device registry of Home Assistant into Netlens: manufacturer, model, area, firmware, protocol (Zigbee, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi), battery level and whether a device has gone unavailable. Devices with a MAC address are matched to the devices Netlens found; the others are listed on the Smart home page with the device they are paired through. Events for devices that go unavailable and for low batteries. Read-only.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: First release. Needs Netlens 0.4.44 or newer (the inventory plugin type and the Smart home page).
